propositions: init.py at 786 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap with only 14 lines of headroom and must be split along the concern boundary between tracker provisioning and tickets-branch convergence

the five ensure units and two content templates have no callers within init.py itself; their sole caller is _store/ensures._registry() which lazy-imports them by name, establishing a clean seam for extraction

moving _GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES, and the five convergence units to a new _init_ensures.py module while re-exporting them from init.py preserves all binding: registry resolution, test imports, and monkeypatch targets

_untrack_runtime_markers_unit must remain in init.py because tests/unit/test_ensures_untrack_markers.py patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute; moving the unit would silently break that patch
after the split, init.py reduces to 610 LOC (well under the 720 near-cap band) and _init_ensures.py is 237 LOC, both clearing their respective constraints, with no existing tests modified
